Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 91. Category: form. Energy of Sesa’s Family.

Rank 3 power-up
Your aura flares a deep blackish red and your eyes
glow white. While you have this form active your
alignment actively shifts 1 step down. (Good 》 Neutral
》Evil)
Increase your Power by 3
You deal an additional 2d4 to all damage
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
